policies.n: Ordinary Serbian passport: obtain a visa before travel through the competent Guinea-Bissau mission. Serbian MFA explicitly says no eVisa or border visa for this route. Passport validity six months; stay not specified.
Ordinary Turkish passport: visa required in advance; Turkish MFA states that border issuance is not available. No duration or electronic-application eligibility is established.

Ordinary Spanish passport, including minors: visa required. Obtain it from the competent mission before travel; Spain reports an inoperative electronic site and unclear/unstable border-issuance conditions. No unrestricted arrival entitlement or duration asserted.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

Ordinary tourist passport: visa required; obtain the visa through the competent Algerian mission. Diplomatic/service exemptions are not ordinary-passport waivers. Stay and nationality-specific electronic eligibility are not established here; no general eVisa-unavailability claim is made.

A consular tourist visa is required for independent travel. A separate southern-Algeria organised-group route uses an approved travel agency, advance QR boarding authorisation, and visa issuance/payment on arrival. Do not assume participation or authorisation. The source’s thirty days describes arrival-visa validity, not a confirmed stay.
policies.label: Visa required; pre-authorised southern-tour option

policies.n: Ordinary German passport: obtain a consular visa before travel. An approved agency invitation with route and duration is mandatory for southern travel; a limited arrival-visa exception exists at selected southern tourism airports for agency-booked journeys and must be confirmed in advance. No general walk-up visa, electronic eligibility, or uniform stay is asserted.
policies.label: Visa required; limited southern-tour option

policies.n: Ordinary short visit under the Immigration Department’s Visa Policy 2025, effective 19 May 2025 and currently linked by the embassy. Nationality is expressly listed or covered by the explicit Schengen group (Liechtenstein). The source does not establish an initial stay duration; d=0. This is visitor visa exemption, not unrestricted residence or employment.

Independent ordinary tourist travel: the embassy’s explicit residual rule requires a visa for countries outside the exemption schedule. Obtain the visa from a competent Gambian mission. The 2025 policy separately exempts tourists on chartered flights and tour operators, but does not specify all operational conditions; do not assume this itinerary-dependent exemption. Arrival visas apply only to certain passport holders whose eligibility is not established here. Stay and electronic eligibility unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; charter-tour exception conditional

policies.n: Ordinary tourist passport: obtain prior clearance from the competent Egyptian authorities and then the visa through the mission with jurisdiction over actual residence. London/Washington procedures are residence-limited; UK/US residence is not assumed. No clearance, visa issuance, duration, or eVisa eligibility is presumed. Palestinian VIP passports and non-tourist Rafah arrangements are outside this ordinary-tourism rule.
policies.label: Visa and prior clearance required

policies.n: Ordinary Bangladeshi passport: Washington expressly requires a visa before entry. Apply through the Egyptian mission competent for actual residence; US residence is not assumed. Duration and other electronic eligibility not established.

The consulate explicitly identifies this nationality as visa-requiring. The older FAQ’s broader clearance roster differs from the newer visa pages; the requirement is preserved without asserting universal prior clearance or excluding an electronic/arrival channel. Use the mission competent for actual residence to establish the applicable method, any sponsor/group/third-country-document conditions, and stay. None of those personal conditions is assumed.
policies.label: Visa required; method/clearance eligibility uncertain

policies.n: A tourist visa is required; London’s Chinese-national instructions establish a consular pathway with employer/university letter and return tickets. Nationality-specific electronic, sponsored-group and arrival methods are not comprehensively established here and are not claimed unavailable. Apply through the mission competent for actual residence. Stay unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; method eligibility uncertain

policies.n: Malaysian nationals may visit without a visa for up to two weeks. For longer stays the usual visa requirements apply.

Ordinary independent visits outside the Jeju concession require a Korean visa; electronic eligibility depends on the visa category and is not established here. Conditional exception: direct international arrival at Jeju airport or seaport for tourism/transit, staying only in Jeju, is visa-exempt for up to 30 days. Mainland transfer is not covered. Separate document-and-itinerary-dependent transit concessions exist (qualifying foreign visas/residence or a recognised escorted Incheon transit tour); none is assumed. Regular visa stay varies.
policies.label: Visa required / Jeju-only 30-day exemption
policies.stay: Jeju-only exemption: up to 30 days; regular visa stay not established

policies.n: Ordinary short tourist visit requires a Korean visa. This nationality is expressly excluded from Jeju’s direct-arrival visa exemption and from the specified third-country-visa/Incheon transit concessions. K-ETA is not a substitute for a required visa. Visa duration and nationality/category-specific eVisa eligibility remain unverified; no eVisa-unavailability or entry-ban claim is made.

Arrival visa/pass at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. DRC is expressly named for a 90-day-valid free visa, while the EAC clause grants a free arrival pass/entry visa for a six-month stay. The common arrival method is established; d=0 preserves the unresolved applicable duration and distinction between validity and stay. Fee-free does not mean visa-free.
policies.label: Arrival visa/pass; duration needs confirmation

policies.n: Rwanda’s all-country arrival-visa rule covers ordinary Somali visitors at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. The source also provides a free six-month EAC pass/entry visa but does not name Somalia in its implementation detail; do not assume the six-month concession. Duration remains unspecified, and a free arrival permission is not encoded as visa-free.
policies.label: Arrival visa/pass; EAC duration unconfirmed

policies.n: HKSAR ordinary passport accepted for arrival access, independently listed by Hong Kong Immigration. Rwanda DGIE establishes the visa-on-arrival method at Kigali International Airport and all land borders. The HKSAR schedule states one month; it is not converted to 30 days. Fee concessions are separate from visa exemption.

Tourist visa required. NTB expressly directs Iranian nationals to a Nepalese mission before departure; London’s on-arrival exception list omits Iran, so arrival eligibility remains conflicting rather than being claimed unavailable. Use the competent mission for actual residence; the London procedure requires physical passport submission despite the ETA name. Choose the applicable tourist visa duration; six-month entry validity is not a stay.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival eligibility unresolved

policies.n: Russian ordinary tourist: Estonia does not ordinarily accept tourist visa applications and prohibits tourist entry across its external border on a short-stay Schengen visa, even one issued by another state. The government FAQ permits entry from within Schengen after lawful Schengen admission; an appropriate valid visa/permission and accepted biometric passport remain necessary. Non-biometric Russian foreign passports are not recognised from 31 March 2025. Specified close-family, residence, D-visa, EU-family and humanitarian exceptions are not assumed. No nationality-wide ban is asserted.
policies.label: Tourism restricted at external border; internal-Schengen exception

findings: Fresh mne.gw ministry homepage, consular page, useful-documents page and overseas-mission directory retrieved. Consular page lists visa issuance as a service but has no nationality exemption/requirement schedule. Most dated homepage news is from 2023; a 2026 copyright/calendar is not a policy update.

The directory identifies the Banjul mission domain; its public homepage returned HTTP 500. Government portal DNS failed; CPLP locator returned 404. No current gazette or nationality schedule establishing general arrival visas/ECOWAS/AES/CPLP concessions was found.

Added ES, RS and TR only from their governments’ explicit ordinary-national requirements. Spanish advice specifically says the electronic site is inoperative and border issuance conditions unclear/unstable.

Prior rgb-visa.com compromise finding retained; that domain was not used or revisited as a policy source. The ministry directory does not authenticate old unrelated mission domains. Remaining origins lack authentic current nationality/document-specific evidence; regional membership alone is not enough.

Fresh source-language gazette: Law 08-11, Official Journal 36 of 2 July 2008, articles 7–12. It reserves visa-abolition agreements and recognised documents; article 11 onboard/transit exceptions are not a general shore-tourism waiver. Article 8 distinguishes two-year visa validity from ninety-day maximum stay.

Fresh Helsinki/London lists still say Morocco exempt and omit HKSAR; the New York fee/application interface has the same stale-waiver issue and is not treated as an exhaustive current nationality checker. Moscow, Madrid and Beijing modern mission pages returned sparse template content without an operative nationality schedule. MFA sitemap path was a soft HTML page; Interior TLS verification failed.

Added CA, FR, DE, RS, SG, TR via explicit fresh origin-government evidence. French/German southern-tour exceptions retained as conditional agency/route/advance-approval procedures, not general VOA. France’s thirty-day wording is validity, not stay.

The gazette and generic MFA default cannot safely resolve the remaining nationality set without the current bilateral/ordinary-passport schedule and Morocco change. MA and special passports IL/XK/PS/TW/MO remain among the blockers. No unsupported global visa default was added.

Major new primary evidence: stamped Immigration Department Visa Policy 2025, effective 19 May 2025, directly linked by the current Brussels embassy visa page. All eight scan pages visually inspected and transcribed. It supersedes the 2019 schedule for expressly named current exemptions.

Named AU/Commonwealth/Balkan exemptions include BF/ML/NE, both Congos, Somalia and Kosovo. This is national implementation evidence; no reciprocity inference. UAE/Turkey explicitly exempt. Liechtenstein covered by explicit Schengen clause.

Independent residual requirements rely on the embassy’s explicit countries-not-listed-must-apply rule, not mere omission. Charter/operator exemption is conditionally described; the PDF does not establish universal VOA. Durations unspecified in new policy, so d=0.

Retained unresolved: old explicit visa-free/clearance-only nationalities absent from the new named list, plus HK/MO/PS/TW document cases. Absence alone does not prove that an old bilateral exemption was revoked. The 2019 PDF is comparison material only; no historical additions.

Fresh London visa and FAQ pages, Washington detailed visa page and official tourism FAQ inspected. Washington includes a September 2026 airport QR-issuance note, but that is not advance eVisa eligibility. US Green Card VOA is residence/document-dependent and is not assumed.

Added explicit named visa-requiring nationalities while preserving uncertain electronic/arrival/clearance methods. Current short pre-clearance list and older broad FAQ list differ; only their common requirement is retained for additional named nationals. MY two-week exemption is expressly stated and uses 14 days.

No default was expanded from the inaccurate “everyone needs a visa” sentence: same FAQ contains Malaysia and Sinai exceptions. Complete current GCC/SAR/Jordan-passport, age/sex, group, sponsor and port branches remain unavailable. AF/DZ/MA/TN/LB/LY/SS/YE age/group reports require primary confirmation; IL’s territorial procedure, HK/MO and other omitted origins remain unresolved.

HKSAR government schedule lists Egypt 90 days but its heading combines visa-free and arrival access without a row-specific method; that alone was not forced into either category. Malaysian MFA PDF TLS failed. China consular index had no additional operative tourist condition on the retrieved page.

Fresh Hi Korea source-language immigration page establishes direct-arrival Jeju-only thirty-day exemption and its explicit 23-country exclusion list. KTO default and current K-ETA roster establish ordinary mainland visa requirement for the newly added origins. No unchecked blanket eVisa-unavailability claim.

Conditional regional and transit branches are recorded without assuming direct Jeju arrival, foreign visas/residence, escort/tour participation, or mainland transfer permission. Ordinary visa durations remain unspecified.

KP inter-Korean permission remains unresolved. CN and ID need current group-tour rules; Singapore mission’s CN pilot ended 30 June 2026 and is not presented as current. The immigration eVisa page includes older 2016/2018 group information rather than a reconciled 2026 nationality schedule. PS/XK are named Jeju exclusions but accepted-document/ordinary tourist issuance remains unsettled.

Fresh central DGIE source confirms universal arrival method. DRC’s explicit 90-day-valid free visa and EAC six-month pass differ on duration, not the common arrival pathway; resolved with d=0. SO likewise retains uncertain implementation/duration of newer EAC membership rather than assuming six months. The Rwanda-in-China page repeats Switzerland/CHF instructions and an older five-member EAC list; it is retained as a template/staleness finding, not candidate supporting evidence.
HKSAR document acceptance independently confirmed by fresh Hong Kong Immigration schedule; destination source establishes arrival visa, origin schedule one-month stay. No conversion to thirty days.
MO/PS/TW/XK remain unresolved: all-country wording alone does not settle these specific accepted-document cases.

Fresh Turkmen Embassy Beijing consular directory and linked visa instructions retrieved: Migration Service invitation, original passport named in invitation, bank receipt and health examination. Fee bands are not verified tourist stays.

The Beijing source does not name HK/MO/PS/TW/XK or establish their document acceptance. No inference that mainland Chinese procedures cover SAR/Taiwan documents; no functioning nationality-specific tourist eVisa evidence obtained. All five remain unresolved.

Fresh PICA table, Toronto official consulate page and its April 2026 requirements PDF inspected. PDF contains application documents, not a nationality schedule. PICA names DRC/former Zaire but does not settle Republic of Congo; PS/TL/VA also absent.

Toronto gives any-nationality same-vessel cruise exception and separate Taiwanese affidavit procedure. Those do not establish an ordinary independent-tourism rule for the four missing origins. No nationality default from the application intake form. All four remain unresolved.
Fresh bilingual government entry pages, very detailed PSP FAQ, tourism page, government search and PSP main site inspected. Old linked accepted-document paths returned 404; service menu timed out.

Taiwan Compatriot Permit acceptance/waiver is explicit, but a Taiwan passport alone is not equivalent to that permit. FAQ references Taiwan travel documents for worker/student automated clearance, which is not an ordinary tourist determination. PS/XK document acceptance remains unestablished. All three retained unresolved.

Fresh NTB and London mission establish Iranian visa requirement. Arrival exception disagreement remains, but it no longer blocks preserving the common requirement with explicit method uncertainty. Mission ETA includes physical passport submission and is not labelled online-only eVisa.

DOI/TIA failed TLS verification; Doha/Berlin/Islamabad guessed visa paths returned navigation shells without the needed rule. XK recognition was not proved by any retrieved nationality-specific evidence. XK remains unresolved.

Fresh MFA linked crisis-government FAQ resolves RU with external-border tourist refusal versus allowed internal-Schengen entry. Recorded as a conditional restricted visa route rather than a nationality-wide entry ban.

Biometric passport recognition rule from 31 March 2025 retained; visa-application restrictions, D-visa/residence/family/humanitarian exceptions distinguished. No assumed exception. All baseline gaps resolved.

Fresh current Migration Agency visiting-Sweden guidance explicitly lists Somalia as visa-required and explains some limited-territorial visas. This does not override the baseline EU matrix’s ordinary Somali passport non-recognition.

Nairobi mission retrieval returned 403 and was not bypassed. No specific ordinary Somali tourist alternative-document issuance path was substantiated; nationality visa requirement plus document rejection is not a universal admission ban. SO remains unresolved.
Fresh Immigration news search and additional MFA visa pages attempted; news search yielded no Kosovo rule, MFA endpoints only returned a twelve-character JavaScript shell.
Baseline ordinary selector omission remains unresolved. No recognition or special tourist approval path established for XK, and no admission ban or eVisa entitlement inferred.
